Resolves #3256

Extends `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` so generating any view class (`isViewBaseClass(baseClass)` — walking each `src/` class's `@extends Neo.<ns>` JSDoc tag up to `component.Base`) supports `-C, --createController <value>` and `-p, --createStateProvider <value>` (and prompts interactively when not in `--drop` mode and not targeting core `src/` classes) to generate and wire a companion `controller.Component` (`${file}Controller`) and/or `state.Provider` (`${file}StateProvider`) into the generated view via `adjustView()`. Also updates `adjustView()` config ordering so public configs (`controller`, `stateProvider`) are inserted before underscore-prefixed private/protected configs (`_vdom`).

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline pr-body, substrate-size ran` (`change-class: capability`).

Evidence: L1 (unit test execution via `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs`) → L1 required (CLI class generator behavior verified in hermetic temp workspaces).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
| :--- | :--- |
| Generate and wire companion `controller.Component` and `state.Provider` when generating any class extending `component.Base` | `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs` (`16 passed`, covering `container.Base`, `component.Base` `_vdom` ordering, `-b form.Container` `@extends` chain walk outside the 5 interactive choices, pre-existing companion reuse without overwrite, and `'no'` suppression) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Modernized `model.Component` from the original 2022 ticket text to `state.Provider` (`Neo.state.Provider`).

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] None required; covered by `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createClassModelStore.spec.mjs`.
